title: 计划排演经典小说短剧，写邮件邀请外国朋友John参加
prompt_en: Suppose you are planning a short play based on a classic Chinese novel. Write your friend John an email to: 1) introduce the play, and 2) invite him to take part in it.
prompt_cn: 假设你正在计划一部基于中国经典小说的短剧。给你的朋友John写一封电子邮件：1) 介绍该短剧；2) 邀请他参加。词数100词左右，署名使用 Li Ming。
sample_essay:
Dear John,

    I am writing to share some exciting news with you. Our drama club is currently planning a short stage play adapted from the classic Chinese novel "Journey to the West", and I would love to invite you to join us.

    The play highlights the adventurous spirit and teamwork of the Monkey King and his companions, featuring vibrant traditional costumes and expressive stage dialogues. Given your keen interest in traditional Chinese culture and your impressive acting talent, we believe you would be an ideal candidate for one of the key supporting roles. Rehearsals will commence next Saturday afternoon in the university auditorium.

    It would be fantastic to have you on board. Please let me know your decision at your earliest convenience.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

analysis.structure: 首段开门见山说明写信意图并发出邀请；次段生动介绍短剧内容并阐明邀请对方的理由；末段礼貌期盼回复并表达热情。
scoring_points: 完全覆盖短剧介绍与邀请要点
交代排练时间与地点，信息饱满
语域亲切得体，格式完全合规
highlights: adapted from the classic Chinese novel (分词后置定语)
Given your keen interest in... (鉴于/考虑到，高级因果引导)
an ideal candidate for... (理想人选)
at your earliest convenience (得体的公文与书信收尾句)

title: 某社区老年人日常休闲/业余活动类型调查
prompt_en: Write an essay based on the chart below. In your writing, you should: 1) interpret the chart, and 2) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 图表展示了某社区老年人主要日常业余休闲活动类型及参与比例（体育健身42%、文化娱乐31%、数字阅读/社交18%、其他9%）。请描述图表并给出评论分析。
sample_essay:
The bar chart above clearly illustrates the distribution of leisure activities among the elderly in a certain community. As is vividly revealed by the data, physical fitness ranks first, accounting for 42%, closely followed by cultural and entertainment pursuits at 31%. In contrast, digital reading and social networking comprise 18%, while other miscellaneous activities take up the remaining 9%.

A multitude of driving factors contribute to this social phenomenon. Foremost among them is the growing health consciousness among senior citizens, who increasingly prioritize longevity and physical well-being through routine outdoor exercise. Furthermore, the expansion of community cultural centers provides senior residents with accessible venues for singing, dancing, and chess, thereby enriching their spiritual retirement life. Lastly, the steady rise in digital entertainment reflects the gradual adaptation of the silver generation to modern smartphone technology.

In conclusion, the diverse leisure choices demonstrate a significant improvement in the quality of life for the elderly. To foster an age-friendly society, communities should continue investing in accessible recreational facilities.

analysis.structure: 第一段规范点出图表主题并由高到低对比数据；第二段从健康意识、社区设施、银发族触网三个维度深入归因；第三段总结提炼并对适老化社会建设提出积极展望。
scoring_points: 核心数据与占比词汇多样（account for, closely followed by, comprise）
归因紧扣人口老龄化背景与时代特征
逻辑链条清晰递进
highlights: ranks first, accounting for... (伴随分词表数据)
Foremost among them is... (倒装强调主因)
health consciousness (健康意识)
the silver generation (银发一代/老年群体的高级地道表达)
foster an age-friendly society (构建老年友好型社会)

title: 与Jack合作开展古镇老建筑保护调查，写邮件提出计划并征求意见
prompt_en: Suppose you and Jack are going to do a survey on the protection of old houses in an ancient town. Write him an email to: 1) put forward your plan, and 2) ask for his opinion.
prompt_cn: 假设你和Jack打算对古镇老房子保护情况展开调研。写邮件给他：1) 提出你的初步调查方案；2) 征求他的意见。词数100词左右，署名 Li Ming。
sample_essay:
Dear Jack,

    I am writing to share my tentative plan regarding our upcoming field survey on the preservation of old houses in the ancient town.

    To make our investigation both efficient and comprehensive, I suggest we divide our work into two phases over the coming weekend. On Saturday, we can conduct on-site inspections, taking photographs of the architectural structures and evaluating their physical damage. On Sunday, we could distribute questionnaires to local residents and interview village elders to understand historical records and current protection difficulties. Afterwards, we can compile the findings into a research report.

    Do you have any suggestions or alternative ideas about this schedule? Please feel free to let me know.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

analysis.structure: 第一段开门见山说明关于古镇调研方案的来信目的；第二段分两阶段规划周末实地调研与问卷访谈；第三段礼貌征询建议。
scoring_points: 计划详实具备很高的实操性

distribute questionnaires to... (发放问卷)

title: 某高校学生劳动实践课收获调查
prompt_en: Write an essay based on the chart below, which shows the benefits gained by university students from labor practice courses. In your writing, you should: 1) interpret the chart, and 2) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 图表展示了某高校大学生从劳动实践课程中的各项收获：获取知识 90%、动手操作能力 80%、心情愉悦 50%、合作精神 30%。写一篇作文解读图表并发表评论。
sample_essay:
The bar chart above provides a clear breakdown of the benefits acquired by college students from labor practice courses. As depicted in the data, the vast majority of students, accounting for 90%, report that they gained practical knowledge. Following closely, 80% of participants improved their hands-on skills, while experiencing pleasure and cultivating cooperative spirit take up 50% and 30% respectively.

Several crucial factors explain why labor education yields such fruitful outcomes. Primary among these is that combining theoretical classroom instruction with practical physical work enables undergraduates to deepen their academic understanding in real-life contexts. In addition, performing tangible tasks provides youngsters with an effective emotional outlet to relieve academic stress, bringing about genuine happiness. Finally, collaborative labor endeavors cultivate problem-solving capacities and interpersonal teamwork.

From my perspective, labor courses are indispensable for well-rounded higher education. Universities should organize more diversified labor activities to encourage students to embrace both knowledge acquisition and holistic character building.

analysis.structure: 第一段精准归纳四大维度百分比数据；第二段从理论联系实际、压力释放、团队协作三个层次深刻剖析收获原因；第三段升华劳动教育对全面发展的长远价值。
scoring_points: 数据层次分明且表达多样化

title: 周日有艺术展和机器人展，朋友David询问去哪个，写邮件给出建议和理由
prompt_en: An art exhibition and a robot show are to be held on Sunday, and your friend David asks you which one he should go to. Write an email to him to: 1) give your recommendation, and 2) give your reasons.
prompt_cn: 周日将同时举办艺术展和机器人展，朋友David来信咨询去哪一个。写邮件：1) 给出你的推荐；2) 详细说明理由。约100词，署名 Li Ming。
sample_essay:
Dear David,

    I am delighted to receive your message asking for advice. Between the upcoming art exhibition and the robot show, I would strongly recommend attending the robot show this Sunday.

    There are two primary reasons behind my recommendation. First of all, the robot show features cutting-edge artificial intelligence and interactive humanoid robots, allowing visitors to experience futuristic technologies firsthand, which aligns perfectly with your major in computer science. Secondly, the art exhibition will run for an entire month, whereas the robot demonstration is a limited two-day event. Therefore, you can always visit the art gallery at a later date without missing either opportunity.

    I am confident you will find the exhibition inspiring. Wish you a wonderful Sunday!

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

analysis.structure: 首段明确在二者中推荐机器人展；中段从贴合专业背景与时间窗口稀缺性两个极具说服力的角度说明理由；尾段表达美好祝愿。
scoring_points: 两点理由切中要害，逻辑极其严密

cutting-edge artificial intelligence (前沿人工智能)

title: 2012至2021年我国居民健康素养水平变化情况
prompt_en: Write an essay based on the chart below, which shows the changes in health literacy level of Chinese residents from 2012 to 2021. In your writing, you should: 1) interpret the chart, and 2) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 折线图反映了2012年至2021年我国居民健康素养水平从 8.8% 持续攀升至 25.4% 的显著变化趋势。请描述图表并深入剖析原因与评论。
sample_essay:
The line graph presents a conspicuous upward trend in the health literacy level of Chinese residents from 2012 to 2021. As can be observed from the statistics, the literacy rate stood at merely 8.8% in 2012. Over the subsequent decade, this figure witnessed steady and continuous growth, eventually climbing to 25.4% in 2021, nearly tripling the initial level.

This encouraging transformation can be attributed to several pivotal factors. Above all, economic development and rising living standards have prompted individuals to shift their focus from basic material sustenance to physical wellness and preventive healthcare. In addition, the proactive implementation of national health initiatives, such as the Healthy China 2030 strategy, has greatly popularized medical hygiene knowledge. Moreover, modern digital platforms have made scientific health guidelines readily accessible to millions of households.

To encapsulate, the climbing curve mirrors our society's comprehensive advancement in wellness awareness. Looking ahead, continuous nationwide education will undoubtedly pave the way for a healthier population.

analysis.structure: 首段描述折线图由 8.8% 持续增长到 25.4% 近乎翻三倍的宏观走势；次段从生活水平提升、健康中国政策引导、互联网科普普及三方面剖析深因；尾段总结与前瞻。
scoring_points: 折线图走势动态词汇丰富（upward trend, climbed to, tripling）
社会宏观归因站位高、视野广
论证严谨规范

pave the way for... (为...铺平道路)

title: 筹办校园美食节，给留学生写邮件介绍活动并邀请参加
prompt_en: Suppose you are planning a campus food festival. Write an email to international students in your university to: 1) introduce the festival, and 2) invite them to attend.
prompt_cn: 假设你正在筹划校园美食节。请给本校留学生写一封邮件：1) 介绍美食节活动；2) 邀请他们参加。词数100词左右，署名 Zhang Wei。
sample_essay:
Dear International Students,

    On behalf of the Student Union, I am thrilled to inform you that our annual Campus Food Festival will take place next Friday, May 20th, in the Central Plaza.

    Designed to celebrate culinary diversity and foster cultural exchange, the festival will feature authentic regional delicacies from across China, alongside interactive culinary workshops where participants can make traditional dumplings and noodles. In addition, you are welcome to set up international stalls to showcase cuisine from your own home countries. The festival will commence at 10:00 a.m. with free food vouchers provided upon registration.

    We wholeheartedly invite you to join this gastronomic feast. We look forward to meeting you there!

Yours sincerely,
Zhang Wei

analysis.structure: 首段亮明学生会身份并宣告美食节举办日期地点；次段详尽介绍各地特色佳肴、动手体验及设立国际摊位的双向交流机制；尾段发出诚挚邀请。

title: 2018至2020年我国总快递件数与农村快递件数变化情况
prompt_en: Write an essay based on the chart below, which shows the express delivery packages in China and rural areas from 2018 to 2020. In your writing, you should: 1) interpret the chart, and 2) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 柱状图展示2018-2020年中国快递总量从510亿件增长至840亿件，农村快递从120亿件激增至300亿件。写短文解读数据并分析评论。
sample_essay:
The bar chart illustrates the dramatic expansion of China's express delivery industry between 2018 and 2020. According to the data, the total volume of delivery packages soared from 51 billion in 2018 to 84 billion in 2020. Concurrently, parcels handled in rural regions experienced even faster growth, surging from 12 billion to 30 billion over the same period, more than doubling in scale.

Two major engines propel this remarkable boom. On the one hand, the flourishing development of e-commerce platforms and digital payment systems has transformed retail patterns, enabling consumers to shop conveniently from home. On the other hand, sustained governmental investment in rural logistics infrastructure and telecommunication networks has successfully eliminated shipping barriers, allowing agricultural produce to reach nationwide markets efficiently.

To conclude, the rapid delivery growth reflects both economic vitality and narrowing urban-rural divides. It is projected that modern logistics will continue to stimulate domestic consumption and empower rural revitalization in the long run.

analysis.structure: 第一段精炼对比全国总量与农村快递的飞速激增；第二段从电商下沉普及与国家农村物流新基建两个核心抓手剖析驱动力；第三段总结提炼其对乡村振兴的战略意义。
scoring_points: 数据动词使用极其高阶（soared, surging, doubling）

结尾升华深刻
highlights: dramatic expansion (剧烈扩张/迅猛增长)
rural logistics infrastructure (农村物流基础设施)

title: 组织在线学术会议，给留学生Jack写邮件邀请参加并告知会议细节
prompt_en: Suppose you are organizing an online meeting. Write an email to Jack, an international student, to: 1) invite him to attend, and 2) tell him the details.
prompt_cn: 假设你正在组织一场线上会议。给国际学生Jack写邮件：1) 邀请他出席；2) 告知会议具体细节（时间、议程、准备工作）。约100词，署名 Li Ming。
sample_essay:
Dear Jack,

    I am writing to cordially invite you to an upcoming online academic symposium organized by our department on cross-cultural communication.

    The virtual conference is scheduled for this Saturday, November 15th, from 2:00 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. via Zoom (Meeting ID: 888-2021). title: 某市居民体育锻炼方式/偏好调查（独处、朋友同行、家人同行）
prompt_en: Write an essay based on the chart below, which shows the survey results about exercise preferences among residents in a certain city. In your writing, you should: 1) interpret the chart, and 2) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 柱状图展示某市居民运动锻炼偏好方式：独自一人约54%、与朋友结伴约47%、与家人同行约23%。描述图表并深入剖析原因与评论。
sample_essay:
The bar chart above outlines the diverse exercise patterns preferred by citizens in a particular city. As can be gleaned from the survey, exercising alone takes the lead, favored by 54% of respondents. Working out with friends constitutes the second largest proportion at 47%, while exercising alongside family members accounts for a comparatively smaller share of 23%.

Several rationales account for these varying choices. To begin with, modern urban lifestyles are characterized by fast paces and fragmented schedules, making solitary workouts like jogging or home workouts the most flexible and time-efficient option. In addition, exercising with peers fulfills social needs, offering mutual encouragement and stress relief after demanding work. Conversely, differing physical stamina and busy schedules among family members frequently make coordinated family exercise harder to schedule.

In conclusion, the popularity of physical fitness testifies to heightened health awareness among city dwellers. Regardless of which companionship mode citizens select, regular physical exercise undeniably leads to a healthier lifestyle.

analysis.structure: 第一段准确提炼独自、结伴、家庭三类锻炼比例并排序；第二段剖析现代人生活节奏碎、社交陪伴需求、家庭成员体能与时间差异；第三段总结运动对健康生活的普遍益处。

title: 计划组织国际学生参观历史古迹，发布通知介绍古迹并给出出行建议
prompt_en: Suppose you are planning a tour to a historical site for international students. Write a notice to: 1) briefly introduce the site, and 2) give some tips for the tour.
prompt_cn: 假设你正为留学生计划一次历史名胜古迹之旅。写一则告示（Notice）：1) 简要介绍该历史遗址；2) 给出出行与参观注意事项。词数100词左右，署名 The Student Union。
sample_essay:
Notice

November 20, 2019

    To assist international students in experiencing the profound history of China, a guided tour to the Summer Palace will be held this Saturday, November 23rd.

    Renowned as a masterpiece of Chinese landscape garden design, the Summer Palace integrates natural hills and open waters with pavilions and temples, offering breathtaking scenery and centuries-old imperial heritage. The tour will depart by chartered bus from the East Gate at 8:30 a.m. Participants are advised to wear comfortable walking shoes and bring water bottles. title: 某高校学生手机阅读目的调查（获取资讯、学习知识、休闲娱乐、打发时间等）
prompt_en: Write an essay based on the chart below, which shows the purposes of mobile phone reading among students in a certain university. In your writing, you should: 1) interpret the chart, and 2) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 饼图展示了某高校大学生使用手机阅读的不同目的比例：获取资讯59.2%、学习知识53.5%、休闲娱乐41.3%、打发时间17.2%、其他。写短文解读并评论。
sample_essay:
The pie chart above clearly portrays the diverse motivations behind mobile reading among undergraduates in a university. As demonstrated by the statistical data, gathering news and information tops the list at 59.2%, closely accompanied by acquiring knowledge at 53.5%. Meanwhile, leisure and entertainment takes up 41.3%, whereas killing time occupies a smaller percentage of 17.2%.

Two primary dynamics explain this reading behavior. Primarily, the ubiquitous presence of smartphones and mobile internet enables students to access up-to-date headlines and academic resources instantaneously, breaking temporal and spatial boundaries. Furthermore, facing competitive academic pressures, university youths actively utilize fragmented moments—such as commuting or queuing—to absorb professional materials and broaden their intellectual horizons while seeking psychological relaxation.

In summary, mobile reading has emerged as an indispensable learning companion. Nevertheless, students should strike a prudent balance between superficial fragmented reading and deep, rigorous contemplation to cultivate truly systematic knowledge.

analysis.structure: 第一段规范点出饼图各比例分布；第二段剖析智能手机即时获取信息的媒介属性与大学生碎片化学习、纾解学业压力的现实需求；第三段辩证提醒深浅阅读平衡。

title: 受史密斯教授委托筹划城市交通辩论赛，写邮件提出辩题及安排
prompt_en: Suppose Professor Smith asked you to plan a debate on the theme of city traffic. Write him an email to: 1) suggest a specific topic with your reasons, and 2) tell him about your arrangements.
prompt_cn: 假设史密斯教授让你筹划一场以城市交通为主题的辩论赛。写邮件给他：1) 提出具体辩题及理由；2) 说明赛事具体安排。约100词，署名 Li Ming。
sample_essay:
Dear Professor Smith,

    I am writing to submit my proposal regarding the upcoming debate on city traffic as you requested.

    I suggest our debate topic be: "Should Private Cars Be Restricted in Megacity Centers to Alleviate Congestion?" This topic is highly topical and directly touches upon the daily commute of urbanites, balancing environmental protection against personal travel convenience. Regarding the event arrangements, the preliminary round is planned for next Wednesday evening in Lecture Hall B, featuring four teams arguing both affirmative and negative sides. We will invite three professors from the Transportation Department to serve as panel judges.

    Please let me know if any adjustments are needed. Thank you for your guidance!

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

serve as panel judges (担任评审团评委)

title: 某高校2013-2018年毕业生去向规划变化（升学深造、找工作、创业等）
prompt_en: Write an essay based on the chart below, which shows the choices of college graduates from 2013 to 2018 in a university. In your writing, you should: 1) interpret the chart, and 2) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 柱状图展示某高校2013-2018年毕业生去向变化：直接就业比例由68.1%显著下滑至60.7%，升学考研深造由26.3%强劲攀升至34.0%，自主创业在2.6%小幅波动。写短文解读并评论。
sample_essay:
The bar chart above outlines the shifting career choices of undergraduates in a Chinese university from 2013 to 2018. Over the five-year span, the percentage of students entering the workforce directly exhibited a noticeable downward slope from 68.1% to 60.7%. In stark contrast, those opting for postgraduate education experienced a pronounced rise from 26.3% to 34.0%, while entrepreneurs remained relatively steady around 2.6%.

A host of underlying elements account for this evolving distribution. Primarily, the increasingly competitive job market places higher premiums on advanced academic degrees, prompting undergraduates to pursue postgraduate study to bolster their core competence. In addition, rapid industrial modernization demands high-caliber professionals equipped with interdisciplinary research expertise rather than merely general undergraduate training.

To sum up, the surging enthusiasm for further education reflects youth's proactive preparation for professional challenges. Nonetheless, graduates should make rational choices matching personal aptitude instead of blindly following trends.

analysis.structure: 首段对比就业比例下降与考研深造强劲增长态势；第二段从人才市场竞争升级与国家产业转型对高精尖人才需求两重维度深刻归因；第三段辩证建议结合自身能力理性选择。
scoring_points: 走势描摹精准（downward slope, pronounced rise）
归因紧扣宏观就业生态
结尾理性警示盲从
highlights: exhibited a noticeable downward slope (呈现明显的下行走势)
In stark contrast (形成鲜明对比)
places higher premiums on... (对...赋予更高溢价/更重视)
bolster their core competence (增强核心竞争力)
blindly following trends (盲目跟风)

title: 因故取消拜访史密斯教授的旅行计划，写信致歉并约定下次会面
prompt_en: Suppose you have to cancel your travel plan and can't visit Professor Smith. Write him a letter to: 1) apologize and explain the reason, and 2) suggest a meeting at another time.
prompt_cn: 假设你因故必须取消旅行计划而无法按期拜访史密斯教授。写一封信：1) 致以诚挚歉意并解释客观原因；2) 建议另择时间见面。词数约100词，署名 Li Ming。
sample_essay:
Dear Professor Smith,

    I am writing to express my deepest apologies for having to cancel our scheduled meeting in your city this coming Friday.

    An unexpected academic emergency arose yesterday: our research lab has been selected to undergo an urgent national project review, requiring all team members to remain on campus for defense preparations over the entire weekend. Knowing how valuable your time is, I genuinely regret any inconvenience my sudden cancellation may cause. If your schedule allows, could we reschedule our meeting to the second weekend of next month? I will gladly travel to your university at your convenience.

    Thank you very much for your kind understanding.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

analysis.structure: 首段开门见山致歉并指明不得不取消周五会面的事实；中段给出国家级项目紧急答辩的充足客观不可抗力理由，并表达内疚与歉意；尾段给出下月第二个周末的具体替代时间方案。
scoring_points: 道歉理由充分且尊重对方
补救方案具体可行
语气诚恳谦逊
highlights: express my deepest apologies for... (为...表达最深切的歉意)
undergo an urgent national project review (接受紧急国家级项目评审)
at your convenience (在您方便的时候)
kind understanding (体谅与理解)

title: 2017年某市消费者选择餐厅时关注的因素调查
prompt_en: Write an essay based on the chart below, which shows the factors consumers consider when choosing a restaurant in a city in 2017. In your writing, you should: 1) interpret the chart, and 2) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 饼图展示2017年某城市消费者选择就餐餐厅时所考量的主要因素：特色特征 36.3%、服务质量 26.8%、就餐环境 24.2%、价格 8.0%、其他 4.7%。写短文解读图表并发表评论。
sample_essay:
The pie chart depicts the primary considerations influencing consumers' choices of restaurants in a city in 2017. As revealed by the investigation, unique food features rank as the most critical factor, commanding 36.3%. Service quality and dining environment constitute 26.8% and 24.2% respectively, while price accounts for merely 8.0%, alongside 4.7% for other miscellaneous aspects.

These statistics illuminate significant transformations in contemporary dining psychology. First and foremost, thanks to steady income growth, citizens are no longer solely driven by economic frugality; instead, they seek distinctive taste sensations and culinary innovation. Furthermore, with rising living standards, dining out has evolved into a comprehensive lifestyle experience, wherein attentiveness of staff and aesthetic ambiance play indispensable roles in satisfying spiritual gratification.

In conclusion, modern diners prioritize culinary uniqueness and experiential quality over pure monetary cost. Restaurant operators should consequently focus on enhancing service excellence and signature dishes to remain competitive in today's catering market.

analysis.structure: 第一段全面客观陈述特色、服务、环境、价格的份额占比；第二段从恩格尔系数下降、消费升级以及就餐场景化体验三个角度剖析原因；第三段为餐饮企业精细化运营提出建设性意见。
scoring_points: 数据提炼精准（commanding, constitute, merely）
消费心理分析入木三分
立意积极向上
highlights: commanding 36.3% (占据36.3%的高级动词表达)
no longer solely driven by economic frugality (不再仅仅受经济节俭驱使)
culinary innovation (烹饪创新)
aesthetic ambiance (美学用餐氛围)
signature dishes (招牌菜品)

title: 受威廉姆斯教授邀请做中国文化演讲，写回信接受邀请并介绍演讲要点
prompt_en: Suppose you are invited by Professor Williams to give a presentation about Chinese culture to international students. Write a reply to: 1) accept the invitation, and 2) introduce the key points of your presentation.
prompt_cn: 假设你受威廉姆斯教授邀请为留学生做一场中国文化主题讲座。写一封回信：1) 欣然接受邀请；2) 简要介绍你演讲的核心要点。约100词，署名使用 Li Ming。
sample_essay:
Dear Professor Williams,

    I am honored to receive your gracious invitation to deliver a lecture on Chinese culture for international students next month, which I am thrilled to accept.

    To provide the audience with an engaging and insightful overview, my presentation will revolve around traditional Chinese tea culture. Specifically, I plan to cover three key aspects: first, the philosophical connotations of tea symbolizing harmony between humanity and nature; second, the historic evolution of tea ceremonies; and third, an interactive live demonstration of brewing Longjing tea to engage participants.

    I will send over my presentation slides ahead of time for your review. Thank you once again for providing this wonderful platform.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

analysis.structure: 首段优雅致谢并欣然接受演讲邀请；中段以中国茶文化切入，细分哲学意蕴、历史演变、现场泡茶互动三大要点；尾段承诺提前报送PPT。
scoring_points: 演讲主题选材精妙且层次递进
要点完备，文化自信充分彰显
行文礼貌优雅
highlights: gracious invitation (热情厚意之邀)
philosophical connotations (哲学内涵)
harmony between humanity and nature (天人合一)
brewing Longjing tea (冲泡龙井茶)

title: 2013-2015年我国博物馆数量和参观人数变化情况
prompt_en: Write an essay based on the chart below, which shows the number of museums and their visitors in China from 2013 to 2015. In your writing, you should: 1) interpret the chart, and 2) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 折线图反映了2013-2015年中国博物馆数量从4165座增加到4692座，年参观人数从6.38亿人次持续攀升至7.81亿人次的双增长态势。写短文解读并评论。
sample_essay:
The line chart delineates the dual growth of both museums and visitor attendance in China between 2013 and 2015. Over the given period, the aggregate number of museums expanded steadily from 4,165 to 4,692. Parallel to this institutional increase, annual visitors witnessed an even steeper upward trajectory, surging from 638 million to 781 million, registering an increase of over 140 million within two years.

Two predominant forces underpin this museum craze. On one hand, government policies promoting free admission and increased fiscal subsidies have significantly lowered the threshold for the general public to enjoy public cultural resources. On the other hand, economic prosperity has catalyzed citizens' appetite for spiritual enrichment, encouraging families and students to frequent historical exhibitions to cultivate cultural confidence.

In brief, the burgeoning enthusiasm for museums reflects societal cultural renaissance. Public authorities should continue upgrading exhibition technologies—such as virtual reality displays—to make cultural relics even more accessible and engaging for future generations.

analysis.structure: 首段对比描述博物馆场馆总数与访客流量的双重上升斜率；次段从国家公共文化免费开放政策与民众精神文化需求井喷两重维度论证；第三段总结并提出拥抱数字化策展建议。
scoring_points: 双折线复合数据描述流畅自然
归因紧扣文化强国与文化自信
行文极具学术气质
highlights: dual growth (双重增长)
steeper upward trajectory (更陡峭的上升轨迹)
museum craze (博物馆热潮)
cultural renaissance (文化复兴)
virtual reality displays (虚拟现实展陈)

title: 你在翻译比赛中获奖，朋友Jack来信祝贺，写回信致谢并提供翻译建议
prompt_en: Suppose you won a translation contest and your friend, Jack, wrote an email to congratulate you and ask for advice on translation. Write him a reply to: 1) thank him, and 2) give your advice.
prompt_cn: 你在翻译比赛中荣获佳绩，好友Jack发来贺信并向你讨教翻译诀窍。写回信：1) 感谢他的祝贺；2) 慷慨分享你的翻译学习建议。约100词，署名 Li Ming。
sample_essay:
Dear Jack,

    Thank you so much for your warm congratulations on my contest victory; your words truly made my day!

    Regarding your inquiry about improving translation proficiency, I would gladly offer two pieces of practical advice. First and foremost, translation is fundamentally rooted in cross-cultural comprehension rather than mechanical word-for-word substitution; thus, reading bilingual literary works helps internalize idiomatic expressions in both languages. Secondly, daily deliberate practice is crucial: try translating a short column or news editorial every day and comparing your draft with authoritative published translations to identify blind spots.

    I hope these suggestions prove helpful in your studies. Feel free to exchange ideas whenever you wish!

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

analysis.structure: 首段热情回应并致谢朋友的祝贺；中段从文化意合而非机械字面直译、刻意练习与名家译本对照两个专业维度给出建议；尾段鼓励常态交流。
scoring_points: 专业翻译理念与方法极其地道
行文亲切得体
无任何语法漏洞
highlights: truly made my day (真让我格外开心)
cross-cultural comprehension (跨文化理解能力)
word-for-word substitution (逐字死译替代)
daily deliberate practice (每日刻意练习)

title: 某高校学生旅游目的调查（欣赏风景、缓解压力、结交朋友、培养独立等）
prompt_en: Write an essay based on the chart below, which shows the travel purposes of students in a certain university. In your writing, you should: 1) interpret the chart, and 2) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 饼图显示某高校大学生的出游旅行目的分布：欣赏风景 37%、缓解压力 33%、结交朋友 9%、培养独立能力 6%、其他 15%。写短文解读数据并进行评论分析。
sample_essay:
The pie chart above presents the distribution of primary motivations driving college students to travel in a Chinese university. As indicated by the survey, admiring scenic landscapes and relieving mental stress emerge as the two dominant objectives, accounting for 37% and 33% respectively. Making new acquaintances and cultivating personal independence take up 9% and 6%, while other diverse purposes make up the remaining 15%.

A combination of internal psychological and external social factors accounts for these proportions. To start with, university students shoulder intense pressures from exams, theses, and future career hunts; therefore, venturing into natural scenery serves as an ideal sanctuary to unwind and rejuvenate. Furthermore, backpacking and group trips offer youths invaluable exposure to unfamiliar environments, thereby nurturing interpersonal empathy and autonomous life skills beyond textbook confines.

In conclusion, travel has become a multifaceted avenue for undergraduates to pursue holistic wellness and personal maturation. As the old saying goes, "He who travels far knows much." Universities should support constructive field trips to expand students' worldviews.

analysis.structure: 第一段提炼前二主导目标与其余分项；第二段从学业就业压力释放与拓展视野培养独立双重角度剖析；第三段引用名言升华研学旅行对大学生成长的深远意义。
scoring_points: 数据分类归纳条理清楚
心理学与社会学成因分析精炼
引用名言地道有力
highlights: admiring scenic landscapes (欣赏自然风光)
relieving mental stress (缓解心理压力)
an ideal sanctuary to unwind (放松身心的绝佳避风港)
autonomous life skills (自主生活技能)
He who travels far knows much (读万卷书行万里路/远行者见闻广博)

title: 大学将为高中生举办夏令营，写告示介绍活动并招募志愿者
prompt_en: Suppose your university is going to host a summer camp for high school students. Write a notice to: 1) briefly introduce the camp activities, and 2) recruit volunteers.
prompt_cn: 假设你的大学即将为高中生举办一次夏令营。写一则告示（Notice）：1) 简述夏令营主要活动内容；2) 面向在校生招募志愿者及岗位要求。约100词，署名 The Student Union。
sample_essay:
Notice

May 12, 2015

    To help prospective high school graduates experience university life, our university will host a 7-day Summer Camp from July 10th to 16th.

    The camp encompasses campus tours, academic lab workshops, career planning seminars, and friendly sports competitions. To ensure smooth operation, we are currently recruiting 30 enthusiastic student volunteers. Qualified applicants should possess strong English communication skills, a high sense of responsibility, and previous volunteer experience. Selected volunteers will assist with campus navigation, event coordination, and logistics support.

    Interested candidates please submit your application forms to youth@university.edu.cn by May 25th.

The Student Union

analysis.structure: 通知格式完全规范；开头点明夏令营面向群体与举行时间；第二段罗列科研实验室、名师讲座等活动并列出30名志愿者的招募素质要求；末段明确提交报名截止期。
scoring_points: 通知三大件格式齐全
活动与招募要求饱满真实
措辞得体官方

career planning seminars (生涯规划讲座)
high sense of responsibility (高度的责任心)
logistics support (后勤保障支持)

title: 某市居民春节消费支出各部分所占比例调查
prompt_en: Write an essay based on the chart below, which shows the distribution of Spring Festival expenses among residents in a city. In your writing, you should: 1) interpret the chart, and 2) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 饼图展示某市居民过春节期间花销比例：购买年货礼物 40%、聚会聚餐 20%、交通出行 20%、压岁钱及其他 20%。写短文解读数据并进行评论。
sample_essay:
The pie chart above reflects the expenditure structure of citizens in a certain city during the Spring Festival. According to the statistics, purchasing New Year gifts claims the largest slice of the pie at 40%. Meanwhile, dining gatherings, travel transportation, and red packets along with miscellaneous items equally share the remaining budget, each capturing 20% respectively.

Multiple social and emotional dynamics drive this consumption pattern. First and foremost, gift-giving embodies traditional Chinese virtues of mutual filial piety and friendship, encouraging people to purchase festive goods to demonstrate gratitude toward parents, relatives, and colleagues. Furthermore, with the holiday functioning as an annual reunion window, dining together with long-separated relatives and taking long-distance trips back home naturally generate substantial food and transit costs.

In summary, holiday spending epitomizes both flourishing retail vitality and enduring emotional bonds. Nonetheless, citizens should champion rational consumption and avoid ostentatious extravagance, ensuring the Spring Festival remains an occasion of genuine warmth and affection.

analysis.structure: 第一段巧妙用 claims the largest slice 描述礼品大头，其余三项平分秋色各占20%；第二段从走亲访友礼尚往来与年度团圆饭交通刚需展开剖析；第三段呼吁理性节俭、杜绝攀比。
scoring_points: 数据比拟生动形象（largest slice of the pie）
文化内核理解深刻（filial piety）
批判奢靡树立正气
highlights: claims the largest slice of the pie (占据最大的一块蛋糕/份额)
filial piety (孝道/孝敬长辈)
annual reunion window (年度团圆期)
champion rational consumption (倡导理性消费)
ostentatious extravagance (铺张炫耀与奢靡浪费)

title: 即将出国留学合住，写邮件给未来室友介绍生活习惯并询问要求
prompt_en: Suppose you are going to study abroad and share a room with a foreign student. Write an email to your future roommate to: 1) introduce your living habits, and 2) ask about his/her preferences and requirements.
prompt_cn: 假设你即将出国留学并与一位外国室友合住。写一封邮件：1) 介绍自己的起居与生活习惯；2) 询问对方的偏好与要求。词数约100词，署名使用 Li Ming。
sample_essay:
Dear Roommate,

    I hope this email finds you well! As we will soon share a dormitory room at the university this coming autumn, I am writing to break the ice and coordinate our shared living space.

    To help us adjust smoothly, I would like to introduce my daily routines. I am accustomed to keeping early hours, usually rising around 7:00 a.m. and going to bed before 11:00 p.m. In terms of habits, I keep my personal study desk organized and prefer a relatively quiet atmosphere when studying in the room. Are there any particular preferences, quiet hours, or dietary customs you would like us to observe?

    I look forward to meeting you soon and building a comfortable home together!

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

analysis.structure: 首段热情破冰；次段具体介绍早睡早起、桌面整洁、安静自习习惯，并主动询问对方作息与饮食禁忌；尾段表达友好同住期待。
scoring_points: 情境感真实，极富同理心
用词温和亲切
生活细节描述具体
highlights: break the ice (破冰建立联系)
accustomed to keeping early hours (习惯早睡早起)
dietary customs (饮食习俗与禁忌)
build a comfortable home together (共同营造温馨住所)

title: 1990年、2000年与2010年中国城镇人口与乡村人口数量变化
prompt_en: Write an essay based on the chart below, which shows the changes in urban and rural populations in China in 1990, 2000 and 2010. In your writing, you should: 1) interpret the chart, and 2) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 柱状图展示1990、2000和2010年中国城乡人口变化：城镇人口从3.0亿持续跃升到6.7亿，农村人口从8.3亿持续下降到6.7亿。写短文解读并评论。
sample_essay:
The bar chart illustrates the dramatic demographic shift in China's urban and rural populations across three landmark years: 1990, 2000, and 2010. According to the data, China's urban population climbed steadily from 300 million in 1990 to 670 million in 2010, more than doubling. In stark contrast, rural inhabitants declined continually from 830 million to 670 million over the same two decades, reaching parity by 2010.

This profound demographic restructuring is propelled by China's accelerating modernization and industrialization. Decades of economic reform have created millions of manufacturing and service jobs in metropolises, attracting vast agricultural laborers to migrate eastward and inward into cities. Concurrently, government policies upgrading urban infrastructure, education, and medical resources have further accelerated voluntary urban migration.

To conclude, the convergence of urban and rural population lines signifies unprecedented urbanization progress. Looking ahead, policymakers should emphasize coordinated regional development to ensure equitable public services for both urban migrants and rural residents.

analysis.structure: 第一段对比城镇翻倍增长与乡村人口平稳回落至二者持平的数据分界点；第二段从工业化吸收富余劳动力与城镇公共资源虹吸两方面剖析；第三段指出新型城镇化均衡发展要求。
scoring_points: 城乡人口剪刀差描述极其精确（reaching parity）
紧扣改革开放与城市化进程
格局宏阔论证精辟
highlights: dramatic demographic shift (剧烈的人口结构变迁)
reaching parity (达成持平/均等)
accelerating modernization and industrialization (加速推进的现代化与工业化)
equitable public services (均等化的公共服务)

title: 班级为需要帮助的儿童筹备慈善义卖，写邮件通知同学并号召参与
prompt_en: Suppose your class is going to hold a charity sale for kids in need. Write an email to your classmates to: 1) give details about the event, and 2) encourage them to participate.
prompt_cn: 假设你们班级计划为需要帮助的孩子举办一场慈善义卖会。写邮件给全班同学：1) 告知活动时间、地点与筹款宗旨；2) 动员大家捐赠物品并积极参与。约100词，署名 Li Ming。
sample_essay:
Dear Classmates,

    To extend our love and support to underprivileged children in impoverished areas, our class committee has decided to organize a campus Charity Sale next Tuesday, May 14th, in front of the University Library.

    All proceeds from this event will be directly allocated to purchasing winter coats, storybooks, and stationery for a village primary school. We warmly encourage everyone to participate by donating idle items, such as books, handmade crafts, sports gear, or small electronic gadgets. You are also welcome to volunteer at our sales booths.

    Every small contribution makes a tremendous difference in a child's life. Let us join hands and make this charitable endeavor a great success!

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming

analysis.structure: 首段宣告为贫困山区儿童举办爱心义卖的时间地点；中段说明善款全额用于购置文具与御寒衣物，并号召捐赠闲置图书手工艺品或担任摊位志愿者；尾段动员呼吁。
scoring_points: 慈善爱心主题纯正充沛
要点完备号召力强
词汇搭配优美
highlights: underprivileged children (处于困境中的儿童)
all proceeds will be allocated to... (所有收益款项将用于...)
donating idle items (捐赠闲置物品)
makes a tremendous difference (带来巨大而积极的改变)

title: 某高校大一至大四各年级学生兼职比例调查
prompt_en: Write an essay based on the chart below, which shows the proportion of college students taking part-time jobs from freshmen to seniors in a university. In your writing, you should: 1) interpret the chart, and 2) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 柱状图显示某高校四个年级做兼职的学生比例：大一 67.7%、大二 77.9%、大三 87.2%、大四 71.4%。写短文解读数据规律并给出分析评论。
sample_essay:
The bar chart above illustrates the percentage of university students engaged in part-time jobs across all four academic years. As is visibly indicated, the employment ratio exhibits an initial rise followed by a slight dip: starting at 67.7% among freshmen, climbing to 77.9% in sophomore year, reaching its zenith at 87.2% for juniors, and subsequently dropping to 71.4% in senior year.

Several driving factors account for this arched trajectory. In early college years, students gradually gain independence and flexibility, seeking part-time gigs to earn pocket money and accumulate social experience. By junior year, with major coursework largely settled, students actively hunt for corporate internships to bolster their competitive resumes. However, upon entering senior year, demanding graduation dissertations and rigorous preparations for civil service or postgraduate exams compel students to pull back from part-time work.

In conclusion, taking part-time jobs provides undergraduates with practical social acclimatization. Nevertheless, students should ensure that off-campus employment does not compromise their academic performance.

title: 某公司不同年龄段员工工作满意度调查

sample_essay:
The table outlines the results of a job satisfaction survey among employees of different age brackets in a company. Strikingly, younger workers aged 40 or under show the lowest satisfaction, with 64% feeling dissatisfied and none expressing total satisfaction. In contrast, among employees aged between 41 and 50, satisfaction climbs to 40% with zero dissatisfaction. Meanwhile, senior staff over 50 exhibit a balanced stance, with 40% satisfied, 50% neutral, and merely 10% discontented.

This stark disparity across age groups can be explained by differing career phases and life pressures. Younger employees under 40 often face intense burdens—such as purchasing apartments, raising infants, and career stagnation—making them more prone to anxiety and frustration over compensation. Conversely, veteran employees in their forties and fifties enjoy stable professional seniority, established savings, and clearer vocational paths, allowing them to perceive corporate roles with greater contentment.

To improve overall organizational efficiency, corporate management should implement competitive incentive mechanisms and psychological support programs tailored specifically for younger employees.

sample_essay:

title: 2008年与2009年国内轿车市场国产品牌与合资品牌市场份额变化
prompt_en: Write an essay based on the chart below, which shows the market share of domestic and foreign car brands in China in 2008 and 2009. In your writing, you should: 1) interpret the chart, and 2) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 柱状图显示2008与2009年我国汽车市场份额变迁：国产品牌从25%增至接近30%，日系品牌略降至35%左右，美系德系微降或持平。写短文解读并评论。
sample_essay:
The bar chart above provides an informative comparison of market shares among various car brands in China between 2008 and 2009. As the statistics reveal, domestic auto brands made notable headway, expanding their market share from 25% in 2008 to nearly 30% in 2009. Conversely, while Japanese and American brands still occupied substantial shares around 35% and 15% respectively, their dominance saw moderate contraction or plateaued.

This rising trajectory of domestic automobiles can be credited to several advantageous forces. Foremost among them is that Chinese automakers have continuously accelerated indigenous technological innovation and enhanced manufacturing craft, significantly narrowing the quality gap with overseas competitors. Additionally, domestic vehicles offer superior cost-performance ratios and competitive after-sales service, making them exceptionally appealing to middle-income families under favorable national purchase subsidy policies.

In conclusion, the expanding share of indigenous cars symbolizes the rise of homegrown manufacturing prowess. If Chinese enterprises continue prioritizing green energy technology and brand prestige, they will secure an even stronger presence globally.

title: 2000-2008年发展中国家与发达国家移动电话用户数量变化
prompt_en: Write an essay based on the chart below, which shows mobile phone subscriptions in developed and developing countries from 2000 to 2008. In your writing, you should: 1) interpret the chart, and 2) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 柱状图展示2000-2008年发展中国家与发达国家手机订阅用户数变化：发展中国家用户数从约4亿暴增至40亿，增长近10倍；发达国家从约5亿稳步增至10亿，发展中国家全面反超。写短文解读并评论。
sample_essay:
The bar chart above vividly exhibits the massive expansion of mobile phone subscriptions across developed and developing countries between 2000 and 2008. Over this eight-year span, mobile users in developing nations experienced exponential growth, skyrocketing tenfold from approximately 400 million to a staggering 4 billion. Meanwhile, developed countries maintained a steady increase from 500 million to 1 billion, allowing developing nations to dramatically overtake them in total subscribers.

Two major forces underpin this worldwide technological leap. Above all, rapid economic modernization and telecom infrastructure upgrades in emerging markets made wireless cellular networks far cheaper and quicker to deploy than traditional landlines, leapfrogging older communications eras. In addition, mass production drastically reduced device manufacturing costs, enabling low- and middle-income populations across developing territories to easily afford mobile communication for daily commerce and connectivity.

In summary, the telecom explosion demonstrates that digital globalization bridges developmental divides. Mobile connectivity will continue serving as a potent catalyst for socio-economic progress across the developing world.

The chart above delineates a remarkable upward trajectory in the possession of durable consumer goods among Chinese households from 2014 to 2023. As is vividly demonstrated by the data, the ownership of essential home appliances, particularly refrigerators and air conditioners, has experienced steady and sustained expansion over the past decade, with nearly every hundred households equipped with modern appliances.

The profound factors underpinning this transformative shift are twofold. Adjacent to the drawing, a statistical table illustrates a substantial surge in the total number of urban parks over the past few years. title: 半山腰歇脚：坚持不懈与半途而废

As is vividly and subtly portrayed in the cartoon, two mountaineers are resting on their journey up a rugged slope. One exhausted climber sits down on the ground, wiping sweat and lamenting that he cannot go any further. In sharp contrast, his companion stands firmly, taking a sip of water while holding out his hand to encourage his peer to keep pressing onward. The caption underneath explicitly reads: "Halfway Up the Mountain".

The metaphorical implication of this visual scene is both profound and inspiring: it is perseverance that constitutes the indispensable cornerstone of any remarkable accomplishment. In the voyage of life, when confronting daunting bottlenecks, people inevitably diverge in their attitudes. Those who surrender halfway invariably fall victim to momentary exhaustion, thereby losing the precious opportunity to witness the picturesque scenery at the summit. Conversely, individuals endowed with indomitable grit view temporary hardship not as a dead end, but as a stepping stone toward higher horizons. Historical records and personal triumphs abundantly prove that monumental breakthroughs stem from persistent endeavor rather than sheer luck.

From what has been discussed above, it is imperative for us, particularly contemporary college students, to foster psychological resilience in our academic and personal undertakings. Only by arming ourselves with unwavering determination can we conquer looming hurdles and eventually scale the pinnacle of life.

sub_type: 图画/社会现象与低头族
title: 手机时代的聚会（低头族与人际疏离）
prompt_en: Four friends sitting around a dining table, each staring at a smartphone screen instead of talking. Caption: 'Gathering in Mobile Era'. 1) describe the drawing, 2) interpret its meaning, and 3) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 四个朋友围坐餐桌聚会，每个人都在低头刷手机，互相毫无交流。文字说明：“手机时代的聚会”。请描述漫画、阐明深层寓意并给出评论与建议。
sample_essay:
The cartoon above illustrates a thought-provoking scenario that is exceedingly prevalent in contemporary life. Four friends are gathered around a lavish dining table, surrounded by delicious dishes. However, instead of engaging in lively face-to-face conversation, each individual is burying their head in a glowing smartphone screen, entirely absorbed in cyberspace. The caption succinctly crystallizes the theme: "A Gathering in the Mobile Era".

To reverse this worrisome trend, concerted endeavors must be mobilized. Individuals should cultivate digital moderation, consciously putting away mobile phones during family reunions and social gatherings. Only when we strike a balance between technology and humanity can we rebuild genuine intimacy.

title: 文化“火锅”既美味又营养
prompt_en: A boiling hotpot labeled 'Culture' contains various cultural elements like Shakespeare, Confucianism, Kung Fu, Postmodernism. 1) describe the drawing, 2) interpret its meaning, and 3) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 一口热气腾腾的火锅上写着“文化”二字，里面有莎士比亚、儒学、功夫、解构等中外文明要素。文字说明：“文化‘火锅’，既美味又营养”。请描述图画，阐述其寓意并发表评论。

A close examination of the drawing reveals a captivating and symbolic illustration. Centered in the picture is a steamy traditional hotpot labeled "Culture", into which diverse cultural ingredients—ranging from Shakespeare and Einstein to Confucianism, Taoism, and Kung Fu—are blended harmoniously. A culturally inclusive mindset not only invigorates national vitality but also enriches human civilization as a whole.

In contemplation of this inspiring message, we ought to approach distinct cultures with an open mind and steadfast cultural confidence. As college students, it is our duty to champion intercultural dialogues and cherish our indigenous roots, ensuring that different civilizations illuminate one another.

prompt_en: Two students with contrasting habits: one says 'Finish it now and enjoy later', while the other procrastinates saying 'Plenty of time, do it later'. 1) describe the drawing, 2) interpret its meaning, and 3) give your comments.

As Edward Young perceptively remarked, procrastination steals our most irrecoverable asset—time.

From my perspective, overcoming the inertia of delay is vital for college students aiming for distinction. We should break formidable goals into manageable milestones and cultivate the habit of prompt action. Only by doing what should be done today can we greet tomorrow with composure and confidence.

title: 坐拥万卷书叹息书太多 vs 专注精读一本好书
prompt_en: One person possesses overflowing bookshelves but complains he has too many to read, while another earnestly finishes one book. 1) describe the drawing, 2) interpret its meaning, and 3) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 图画对比两人读书状态：一人坐拥满架图书却叹息书太多无从读起；另一人则静心捧读、踏实读透一本书。请描写图画、阐明寓意并评论。160-200词。
sample_essay:
As is vividly portrayed in the drawing, an ironic contrast is drawn between two book owners. On the left side, a man sits surrounded by towering bookshelves, sighing helplessly that he possesses far too many volumes to ever finish. On the right side, however, another reader sits calmly by the window, totally immersed in completing a single masterpiece with deep appreciation.

The drawing conveys a thought-stimulating truth about knowledge acquisition: the quality of focused reading far outweighs the vanity of superficial hoarding. In our information-saturated era, people frequently equate possessing resources with possessing wisdom. Many succumb to the illusion of knowledge by buying mountains of books without ever turning a page. Nevertheless, skimming hundreds of titles fleetingly merely skims the surface, whereas digesting a single masterpiece thoroughly enriches one's intellect and nurtures critical thinking.

In my perspective, real learning demands relentless concentration and disciplined execution. Rather than being paralyzed by the abundance of unread volumes, we should begin with the book right before our eyes, reading it with depth and earnest reflection.

analysis.structure: 第一段以左右对照刻画满架藏书叹息与窗前静读一本的鲜明神态；第二段直击“囤积焦虑”与“拥有资源不等于拥有智慧”的现代人痛点，对比精读对思维的滋养；第三段提出戒除浮躁、专注当下的行动建议。

sub_type: 图画作文（家庭教育与言传身教）
title: 榜样的力量与家庭教育：看电视催读书 vs 陪伴孩子共同学习
prompt_en: Two contrasting fathers: one lies watching TV while urging his son to study; the other studies alongside his child as a role model. 1) describe the drawing, 2) interpret its meaning, and 3) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 图画对比两位父亲：一位自己躺在沙发上看电视却训斥儿子去用功读书；另一位则在书桌旁与孩子共同学习、做榜样。请描述图画、阐释寓意并评论。160-200词。
sample_essay:
The cartoon presents a striking contrast between two parenting styles. In the left frame, a father relaxes comfortably on a sofa watching television, sternly commanding his son, "Go study hard!" In sharp contrast, the father in the right frame sits quietly by his child's side under a warm desk lamp, reading a book together as an inspiring example.

The illustrator astutely exposes a crucial truth in family upbringing: leading by example is incomparably superior to empty preaching. Children are keen observers who naturally imitate parental behavior rather than obey abstract orders. When parents indulge in passive amusement while imposing severe academic demands on their offspring, hypocrisy inevitably breeds resentment and resistance. Conversely, when parents embody self-discipline and intellectual curiosity in daily life, they subtly nurture a lifelong passion for learning in their children's hearts. As Albert Schweitzer famously noted, example is not merely the best way to influence others; it is the only way.

To foster healthy next generations, parents should step down from authoritarian pedestals and become co-learners with their children. Only through genuine companionship can education bear sweet fruit.

analysis.structure: 第一段以左右两幅画面直观描摹训斥与伴读的鲜明对比；第二段深入教育心理学机制，批判双标说教的虚伪，论证潜移默化言传身教的威力，引用史怀哲名言；第三段倡导家长走下威权神坛、与孩子共同成长。

sub_type: 图画作文（孝道美德与相携反哺）
title: 相携三十年：母亲牵幼子与成年子女搀扶衰老母亲
prompt_en: A drawing shows a mother tenderly holding her toddler's hand thirty years ago, and thirty years later, the grown child supporting his aging mother. 1) describe the drawing, 2) interpret its meaning, and 3) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 图画包含两幅温馨画面：三十年前年轻母亲牵着幼童稚嫩的小手；三十年后长大成人的子女深情搀扶着步履蹒跚的年迈母亲。请描述图画、阐述寓意并评论。160-200词。
sample_essay:
The touching drawing spans across three decades to present two intertwined moments. In the first scene, a young mother gently holds her toddler's tiny hand, guiding his fledgling steps with endless patience. In the second scene thirty years later, the roles are reversed: the grown child tenderly supports his stooped, white-haired mother, walking hand in hand down the avenue of life.

The heartwarming picture pays a sublime tribute to filial piety, a cherished cornerstone of traditional Chinese virtues. Filial devotion is fundamentally a reciprocal obligation born out of gratitude. Parents dedicate their prime years and boundless love to nurturing their offspring into maturity. When relentless time bends their posture and dims their eyesight, it is the sacred moral duty of adult children to provide reciprocal comfort and companionship. Sadly, in contemporary society, some individuals neglect their aging parents under the pretext of hectic careers, forgetting that emotional presence outweighs material allowances.

In conclusion, caring for the elderly reflects the moral conscience of a civilized society. We should cherish our parents while time permits, repaying their unconditional love with attentive companionship and heartfelt warmth.

prompt_en: A college graduate stands at a crossroads facing four distinct career paths. 1) describe the drawing, 2) interpret its meaning, and 3) give your comments.

The picture mirrors a common crossroads that almost every university graduate must confront. As higher education expands rapidly, graduating youth are blessed with diversified opportunities yet burdened with severe decision anxiety. What is truly essential is conducting an honest self-assessment and maintaining steadfast determination once a path is chosen. After all, success is determined not by which road we select, but by the relentless effort we invest upon it.

title: 打翻的牛奶瓶：悲观叹息全完了 vs 乐观庆幸还剩一半
prompt_en: A bottle of milk falls on the floor, spilling half. One person laments 'Everything is ruined', while another says 'Fortunately some is left'. 1) describe the drawing, 2) interpret its meaning, and 3) give your comments.
prompt_cn: 图画中一瓶牛奶打翻在地洒出一半：一人抱头痛哭叹息“全完了”；另一人则乐观庆幸“幸好还剩半瓶”。请描述图画、阐述寓意并评论。160-200词。
sample_essay:
As is vividly illustrated in the drawing, a bottle of milk accidentally falls to the ground, spilling half of its liquid. Confronted with the exact same occurrence, two individuals display diametrically conflicting psychological responses. The person on the left covers his face in sheer despair, mourning that "everything is ruined," whereas his companion calmly stoops down, cheerfully remarking that "fortunately there is still some left."

The cartoon conveys an invaluable philosophical lesson regarding life mindset: our reality is molded not by external mishaps, but by the cognitive perspective through which we interpret them. In our lifetime journey, unforeseen misfortunes and setbacks are virtually inevitable. While a defeatist pessimist paralyzes himself in unproductive grief over spilled milk, an unshakable optimist actively directs his attention toward salvaging remaining resources and uncovering hidden opportunities. As the proverbial saying goes, life is ten percent what happens to you and ninety percent how you react to it.

In conclusion, cultivating an optimistic disposition is vital for anyone striving to surmount challenges. Whenever setbacks strike, we must refrain from sterile laments, maintain a hopeful heart, and forge ahead with fortitude.

analysis.structure: 第一段以同一意外事件为基点，生动描画痛哭绝望与乐观庆幸的强烈反差；第二段将牛奶打翻升华至认知视角决定现实高度的哲理，深入对比悲观沉沦与乐观求变的本质差异，自然嵌入名言；第三段呼吁青年保持希望与定力向前看。

Dishearteningly, instead of admiring the natural scenery quietly, they casually discard bottles and plastic wraps into the pristine water, leaving an unsightly trail of floating rubbish behind their boat.

The picture illustrates a distressing conflict between booming tourism and lagging public morality. With living standards rising rapidly, travel has become a popular leisure pursuit. However, uncivilized behaviors like littering not only desecrate picturesque landscapes but also pose grave threats to vulnerable aquatic ecosystems. Such misconduct exposes a glaring deficit in civic decorum and environmental responsibility among certain travelers who prioritize personal convenience at the expense of public well-being.

In my perspective, safeguarding our natural ecology demands collaborative societal endeavors. On one hand, tourism authorities should implement stricter supervision and penalize littering rigorously. On the other hand, public education must be amplified to nurture genuine ecological consciousness. Only when every tourist practices self-restraint can our waters remain lucid and our mountains verdant.

title: 给表弟写信，推荐大学与专业选择建议
prompt_en: Write a letter to a cousin who is going to choose a university and major, offering your advice.
prompt_cn: 给即将填报高考志愿的表弟写一封信，就大学与专业的选择提出建议。署名使用 Li Ming，约100词。
sample_essay:
Dear Cousin,

    Delighted to learn that you achieved excellent marks in your college entrance examination, I am writing to offer a few personal recommendations regarding your university and major selection.

    To begin with, I suggest choosing a major that genuinely ignites your intrinsic curiosity, such as Computer Science or Environmental Engineering, rather than blindly pursuing transient commercial hypes. Furthermore, when selecting a university, prioritize institutions located in dynamic metropolitan centers, as they provide richer internship opportunities and broader intellectual horizons. Lastly, discussing your career inclinations with industry mentors will give you realistic guidance.

    I have full confidence in your judgment. Feel free to ring me if you want to brainstorm further!

Yours affectionately,
Li Ming

NOTICE

March 15th, 2026

The Postgraduates' Association
